adjudication_notes: Strict-tier full-paper review (PDF p. 25): During inference, the operative memory component (Persistent 3D world state (sets, characters, positions)) changes through LLM-mediated memory editing, fixed-rule correction of stored state; the governing policy remains fixed, and any learning reported by the paper occurs before deployment. Training-time learning, when present, was not counted as T3.
